$comment: CRPS-01 deliverable 4 — the generator input for every enumerated column's CHECK list in
001_corpus_schema.sql. The ticket names '002_enums.sql.j2 (or equivalent generator input)'; this
is the equivalent, declarative form, chosen so the repository needs no templating dependency.
`generated`: the column's CHECK list is rendered from the packages/contracts canonical enum
export (FND-03). Editing the SQL by hand instead is a defect and fails tests/schema/
`pending`: PRD names the column as enumerated but packages/contracts publishes no family for it
yet (Q-CRPS-4 / FND-03). The placeholder renders to the empty string, so the column is plain
TEXT with no enum CHECK. Hand-copying the values here or into the SQL is expressly forbidden by
the CRPS-01 Feedback obligation: the fix is an FND-03 ticket change that adds the family, after
which the entry moves from `pending` to `generated` and the CHECK appears with no SQL edit.
Every entry in either array MUST have a matching ${enum_check_<table>_<column>} placeholder in
001_corpus_schema.sql, and every placeholder MUST appear here exactly once.

generated.why_nullable: CRPS-01 creates the column and assigns no value; tier assignment is CRPS-04's policy, so a chunk written by CRPS-03 before tiering runs must be representable. The CHECK still rejects any non-member value.
